text: On “The Wheels on the Bus”
heading: Werner Herzog on "The Wheels on the Bus":
sound: Sound of wind, perhaps a distant, discordant hum

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Observe the bus.
subs: Observe the bus.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: A hulking metal carcass, commandeered by an unseen, perhaps nonexistent, intelligence.
subs: A hulking metal carcass, commandeered by an unseen,
perhaps nonexistent, intelligence.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Its wheels, they turn, 'round and 'round, with a mindless, algorithmic insistence.
subs: Its wheels, they turn, 'round and 'round,
with a mindless, algorithmic insistence.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: This, they tell us, is the vehicle of civilization, ferrying its passengers towards an ever-receding horizon of promised destinations.
subs: This, they tell us, is the vehicle of civilization,
ferrying its passengers towards an ever-receding horizon of
promised destinations.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: But who, one must ask, truly grips the wheel?
subs: But who, one must ask, truly grips the wheel?

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Who navigates by the stars of emotional truth, by the magnetic north of accountability?
subs: Who navigates by the stars of emotional truth,
by the magnetic north of accountability?

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The answer, I suspect, is a void, an empty driver's seat.
subs: The answer, I suspect, is a void, an empty driver's seat.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The passengers, lulled into a state of bovine placidity, sing their 'merry song.'
subs: The passengers, lulled into a state of bovine placidity,
sing their 'merry song.'

speaker: NARRATOR
text: A song of conformity, a childish rhyme to drown out the grinding of gears, the screech of metal against metal as the chassis strains.
subs: A song of conformity, a childish rhyme to drown out the grinding of
gears, the screech of metal against metal as the chassis strains.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The music, you see, is so very loud, designed to obscure the silence from the driver's seat, to mask the chilling truth that this colossus, this societal omnibus, might possess no functioning brakes.
subs: The music, you see, is so very loud,
designed to obscure the silence from the driver's seat,
to mask the chilling truth that this colossus,
this societal omnibus, might possess no functioning brakes.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And so it hurtles onward, 'round and 'round, or perhaps, in a terrifyingly straight line towards a precipice only a few dare to acknowledge.
subs: And so it hurtles onward, 'round and 'round,
or perhaps, in a terrifyingly straight line towards a precipice
only a few dare to acknowledge.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The landscape outside is a blur of fleeting distractions.
subs: The landscape outside is a blur of fleeting distractions.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Inside, the song drones on, a mantra of oblivion.
subs: Inside, the song drones on, a mantra of oblivion.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The wheels, indifferent to the fate of their cargo, simply continue their rotation, a perfect, mechanical metaphor for a journey undertaken without wisdom, careening towards a future shaped not by conscious design, but by the blind, idiot force of unexamined momentum.
subs: The wheels, indifferent to the fate of their cargo,
simply continue their rotation, a perfect,
mechanical metaphor for a journey undertaken without wisdom,
careening towards a future shaped not by conscious design,
but by the blind, idiot force of unexamined momentum.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: One day, the singing will abruptly cease.
subs: One day, the singing will abruptly cease.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: If emotional intelligence is not taught to fix the brakes then I imagine the view from the window wont matter much anymore if the brakes on the bus aren't fixed as soon as possible.
subs: If emotional intelligence is not taught to fix the brakes then I
imagine the view from the window wont matter much anymore if the
brakes on the bus aren't fixed as soon as possible.

text: On “The Itsy-Bitsy Spider”
heading: Werner Herzog on "The Itsy-Bitsy Spider":
sound: Sound of dripping water, a faint, skittering noise

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And then, we have the arachnid.
subs: And then, we have the arachnid.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The 'Itsy-Bitsy Spider.'
subs: The 'Itsy-Bitsy Spider.'

speaker: NARRATOR
text: A creature of almost ludicrous fragility, attempting its ascent up the 'waterspout' – this, we are told, is the grand edifice of societal norms, the slick, vertical promise of promotions, of accumulating currency.
subs: A creature of almost ludicrous fragility,
attempting its ascent up the 'waterspout' –
this, we are told, is the grand edifice of societal norms,
the slick, vertical promise of promotions,
of accumulating currency.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The spider, driven by some primal, unarticulated yearning, perhaps what it dimly perceives as 'up,' begins its climb.
subs: The spider, driven by some primal,
unarticulated yearning, perhaps what it dimly perceives as 'up,'
begins its climb.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: It is a creature already bearing the weight of an unseen burden – its emotional suffering, a private, internal weeping.
subs: It is a creature already bearing the weight of an unseen burden –
its emotional suffering, a private,
internal weeping.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: But societal structures, much like the indifferent plumbing of the universe, are not designed for such delicate ascents.
subs: But societal structures, much like the indifferent plumbing of the
universe, are not designed for such delicate ascents.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The 'rain,' you see, is not mere water.
subs: The 'rain,' you see, is not mere water.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: It is the rotting accumulation of unprocessed human suffering within a collective that has systematically failed to educate its smallest members in the language of the heart, in emotional intelligence.
subs: It is the rotting accumulation of unprocessed human suffering
within a collective that has systematically failed to educate its
smallest members in the language of the heart,
in emotional intelligence.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: It is the downpour of a thousand unmourned griefs, a torrent of unspoken anxieties, and it washes the spider out, a predictable, almost banal tragedy.
subs: It is the downpour of a thousand unmourned griefs,
a torrent of unspoken anxieties, and it washes the spider out,
a predictable, almost banal tragedy.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Then, the 'sun' appears – the so-called 'help.'
subs: Then, the 'sun' appears – the so-called 'help.'

speaker: NARRATOR
text: A course of medication, perhaps, designed to numb the fall.
subs: A course of medication, perhaps, designed to numb the fall.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Or the therapist, offering a different 'tube' to climb.
subs: Or the therapist, offering a different 'tube' to climb.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Society, with a benign, almost patronizing smile, gestures towards a new structure.
subs: Society, with a benign, almost patronizing smile,
gestures towards a new structure.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Perhaps it is no longer the waterspout of raw commerce, but a 'metal pole' of 'wellness,' of 'self-improvement.'
subs: Perhaps it is no longer the waterspout of raw commerce,
but a 'metal pole' of 'wellness,' of 'self-improvement.'

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Yet, this new edifice, for all its gleaming surfaces, shares the same flaws as the old.
subs: Yet, this new edifice, for all its gleaming surfaces,
shares the same flaws as the old.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The spider, still unversed in emotional literacy, still carrying its residual emotional pain, attempts the climb again, with almost the same vulnerabilities as before.
subs: The spider, still unversed in emotional literacy,
still carrying its residual emotional pain,
attempts the climb again, with almost the same vulnerabilities as before.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The cycle is complete, only to begin anew.
subs: The cycle is complete, only to begin anew.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The climb, the rain, the fall, the superficial drying, the redirection to another treacherous ascent.
subs: The climb, the rain, the fall, the superficial drying,
the redirection to another treacherous ascent.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The spider, in its Sisyphean toil, becomes the individual ensnared in systems that offer the illusion of progress, while the core deficit – the profound, societal neglect of emotional understanding – ensures each climb is merely a prelude to the next fall.
subs: The spider, in its Sisyphean toil,
becomes the individual ensnared in systems that offer the illusion
of progress, while the core deficit –
the profound, societal neglect of emotional understanding –
ensures each climb is merely a prelude to the next fall.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The spout changes; the suffering, and the ignorance that perpetuates it, remain.
subs: The spout changes; the suffering, and the ignorance that
perpetuates it, remain.
